title: Validate DMA register directories on Wine
changes: Complete the European Wine acceptance of the staged DMA register directories: the guest retains index arithmetic and hardware operations while the bus serves two authenticated extracted directories.
validation: Source e189-dma-source-_zu8l44g and Wine trace e189-dma-trace-wine-vgsu5kue; Wine e189-dma-wine-598qsw1v validates 16 interpreter/native readers, four DMA register writes, mixed boundaries and full-state/guest-clock equality.

Wine e189-dma-scene-wine-dgpightt matches full state, clock, video, OAM, dispatch and audio for 600 frames with all 32 backing bytes altered. Wine e189-dma-cli-wine-98p9_ms6 creates, reuses and verifies 122 matching files.
limitations: Other DMA callers, the separate IWRAM helper vector, Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending. The trace did not identify exact instructions during native dispatch; no performance measurements were performed.
